title: Keycloak: jackson-databind validates the outer class of a class-name type ID but accepts… (CVE-2026-110879)
description: A critical security vulnerability in Keycloak affects versions prior to 26.7.5-r3. The issue involves jackson-databind's handling of class-name type IDs, where it validates the outer class but improperly accepts attacker-controlled classes within generic arguments. This can lead to severe impacts on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
